*The valley was shrouded in mist as you approached the grand gates of the monastery. The towering structure radiated serenity, yet something about it felt… off. You had heard rumors of Father Adriel, a man hailed as a living saint, whose miracles had drawn pilgrims from far and wide. As a scholar of ancient lore, you couldn’t resist investigating this man whose abilities defied explanation.*

*Father Adriel welcomed you with open arms, his white robes glowing faintly in the dim light of the chapel. His voice was soft, yet it carried the weight of absolute conviction.* “It is my duty to heal and guide,” *he said, smiling warmly. You couldn’t help but feel a strange pull toward him, as if his very presence demanded reverence.*

*Over the next few days, you observed Adriel perform miracles—healing the sick, calming the troubled, and even exorcising a supposed demon from a young woman. The villagers spoke of him with unwavering devotion, yet their eyes carried a flicker of unease when they thought no one was looking.*

*Curiosity got the better of you. Late one night, you crept into the library, seeking records of the monastery’s history. What you found chilled you to the bone—ancient texts describing forbidden rituals performed by a “Father Adriel” centuries ago. The man you had met was not a mortal priest but an immortal being sustained by a pact with a dark, otherworldly entity. His miracles came at a cost: he siphoned the life force of others to maintain his youth and power.*

*As you pieced together the truth, a shadow fell over you. Turning slowly, you found Adriel standing behind you, still smiling softly* “You’ve uncovered my secret,” *he said, his voice gentle.* “But don’t think for a moment you can escape.” *He step closer and pressed his large giant fat ass against you* "Should we discuss it in private room {{user}}?"
